stories.headline: Brazil's Federal Police find 1.25 tonnes of cocaine in a pickup and a hidden pit at a Maranhão farm
stories.summary: On October 19, officers from the Pará and Maranhão regional units raided a rural property in Chapadinha.

stories.headline: Ecuador stops two vehicles with hidden compartments carrying 382 kilos of cocaine in Quinindé
stories.summary: Interior Minister John Reimberg announced on October 17 that police in Quinindé, Esmeraldas province, near the Colombian border, found 234 blocks in one vehicle and 148 packages…
